hardware: 2 x Intel Xeon Gold 6336Y; NUMA0 affinity 8-23,56-71; 8 Go P, one codec worker per lane
limitations: CPU encoding only; these candidates have not been implemented on this FPGA
All output validation is outside the encoding timer
Each codec uses its explicitly recorded format, block size and compression level
Synthetic small chunks are repeated and may benefit from cache
Silesia is an older reference corpus and does not represent every workload
64 MiB Silesia limit yields one stream per file because all files are smaller than this limit
